details:
I know an avatar searching feature has been requested many times before. And I know why you guys hesitate to add it, and honestly I agree with you. But I have a solution to the issue. A suggestion for the Avatar Searching feature if that were to ever become a thing. Basically a way to solve the issue the feature would cause while being able to add the feature.
Problem:
Being able to search for avatars would ruin part of the fun in VRChat. Specifically the avatar hunting aspect of it. Something about finding someone using the exact avatar you've been looking for and being able to clone it is one of the most satisfying feelings in VRChat. You either find an avatar by talking to people and running into someone who has an avatar you want, or exploring worlds and finding one that has an avatar you want. So it basically encourages you to go and talk to people and explore VRChat. If there was an avatar search, you wouldn't need to do that. Just search an avatar and you've got it. Ofc, people may already have other reasons to talk to people and play in different worlds, but the avatars can be like a major bonus or a reward.
Solution: 
If the feature is added, have it so you have to earn the ability to use it. Like, you can only use it if you become a Trusted User. Because at that point, you've already talked to a lot of people and explored a lot of worlds. Or add a currency system.
A currency system (my concept of one) would work like this. For this.
We will call the currency Chatbucks (not Vrbucks because thats too similar to Vbuck).
Basically, the idea is that you gotta pay for the ability to search an avatar with Chatbucks. And you earn Chatbucks by receiving requests, making friends, and exploring new worlds. The earning amount and price would entirely be up to the devs im gonna set my own for the example.
Receiving a friend request = 5 Chatbucks
Making friends = 10 chat bucks 
Staying in a world you've been in for the first time for 10 minutes = 10 chatbucks
favoriting an avatar = 1 chatbucks
Getting votekicked off a game = -5 chatbucks
And if you wanna include VRC+, 5 chatbucks a week. A bonus amount but can't be a replacement to socializing and exploring. 
After you save up, you spend 20 chatbucks to search an avatar. After you've picked an avatar you wanna take, you gotta pay another 20 to search for an avatar.
I wouldn't exactly say the transaction would end at pushing enter on the keyboard alone, since that seems unfair. Various reasons why. Mistype, didn't find desired avatar, broken avatars, desired avatar turning out to have a different name, etc. So instead, maybe let players try out the avatar to see if its broken. And only try it out to make sure the avatar isn't broken. And the avatar trial would be local meaning everyone else would see their fallback avatar. And the avatar unapplies when they switch instances. The transaction is made when they find the desired avatar and purchase it (with chatbucks, not real money).
This method allows us to have the avatar search feature without it ruining avatar hunting. And might make VRChat a little more fun.
(Please just don't add lootboxes and stuff if you end up using the currency idea. Don't become FortChat).
title: solution for Avatar Searching implementation issue
